title: 風塵みたいなあたしでも

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days after attaining her goal of entering the Classics, Mejiro Ryan is faced with burnout from her constant efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unlike Ryan, Ines Fujin has entered the world of racing from a life where she had very little.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She lets Ryan know that her motivation for racing stems from a genuine desire to run for the sake of her family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her own motivation rekindled by this talk, Ryan is now ready to enter the Japanese Derby.
